name: jmcomic-redirect-worker
description: A Cloudflare Worker that tracks published JMCOMIC mainland entry domains and redirects to the latest confirmed target.

STATE.description: KV namespace used to store the last confirmed redirect target and health state.

SOURCE_URL.description: Public release page that lists the current mainland entry domains.

BOOTSTRAP_TARGET.description: Fallback HTTPS URL used before the first successful scheduled check.

CONFIRMATION_COUNT.description: Number of consecutive observations required before changing an existing target (1-5).

TARGET_HOST_KEYWORDS.description: Comma-separated keywords allowed in redirect target hostnames.

PRESERVE_PATH.description: Set to true to append the incoming path and query string to the redirect target.

MAX_SOURCE_BYTES.description: Maximum number of bytes read from the release page per check.
